title: practice sessions
blurb: Weekly training for the William Lowell Putnam Mathematical Competition: one technique per week, a short lecture, then problems.
preamble:
Each week has two identical sessions; come to whichever fits your schedule. A 15-minute mini-lecture on one technique, then 35 minutes of group work on a six-problem handout (two warm-ups, two easy Putnam problems, two hard take-homes). Solutions are posted after Friday's session.

These materials were drafted with the help of an AI assistant (Claude) and reviewed by me before posting.

facts.label: the exam
facts.value: Saturday, December 5, 2026 — four 90-minute sessions with breaks (new this year). Twelve problems, ten points each. [MAA Putnam page](https://maa.org/putnam/)

facts.label: meetings
facts.value:
Thursdays 9:10–10:00 and Fridays 1:40–2:30 in Library 389 (one exception: Fri Nov 13 meets in Library 41)
The two sessions each week are identical

facts.label: registration
facts.value: Any Reed undergraduate can take the exam (at most four times). Email [ormsbyk@reed.edu](mailto:ormsbyk@reed.edu) to get the registration link.
